title: Edit form: a currency field's symbol overlaps the first digit when the symbol is wider than "$" (zh-CN USD shows `US$` over the amount)
body: repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj ① product defect · Source: maintainer — Warren, 2026-11-23 11:00Z in the UI review thread: 「01 立卡派发」 (item 01 of the browser review of latest main, https://claude.ai/artifact/Nh8ZCYjSKEG8SLZJCsBK8b) **What happens.** In the record edit form (dialog and full page), a currency field draws its symbol as an absolutely positioned adornment and reserves a fixed `pl-8` (2rem) of left padding for it. Any symbol wider than about two characters overlaps the typed amount. In the zh-CN console, USD renders as `US$`, so a budget of `150000` reads as `US$50000` — the `$` sits on top of the leading `1`. **Reproduction (measured on main 9348f02b, showcase app, zh-CN browser locale).** 1. Sign in as admin, open Projects → Website Relaunch → Edit. 2. Look at Budget (`150000`) and Spent (`60000`): the leading digit is hidden under `US$`. Screenshot: project files `ui-review-2026-11-23/01-金额前缀压住数字.png`. **Reach.** The symbol comes from `Intl` (`currencySymbol(currency, locale)`), so the width varies by currency × locale. Measured with `Intl.NumberFormat(...).formatToParts`: zh-CN USD `US$`, zh-CN HKD `HK$`, zh-CN JPY `JP¥`, en-US CAD `CA$`, en-US CHF `CHF` all exceed the reserved 2rem; en-US USD `$`, zh-CN CNY `¥`, de-DE EUR `€` fit. Every user editing such an amount sees the wrong-looking number every time. **Where (read).** `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx` — the adornment `{symbol}` (around line 233) and the input's fixed `symbol ? 'pl-8' : ''` (around line 258). The grid cell editor `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/grid-field/GridFieldWidget.tsx` uses a fixed `pl-6` for its adornment (around line 1607) and should be checked for the same overlap. **Expected.** The amount is never covered: the input's left inset follows the rendered symbol width (or the symbol sits outside the input as a leading addon), for any currency × locale. **Acceptance.** A test pins a wide symbol (`US$` under zh-CN, `CHF` under en-US) and asserts the input reserves at least the symbol's width; browser screenshot of the showcase edit form in zh-CN with the full amount visible. Grading (proposed): `area:data` · Bug · UX rule — a core feature ("every field type renders, accepts input") hit by every user who edits a wide-symbol currency, every time ⇒ p1 · evidence: measured (screenshot) + read (CurrencyField.tsx). Dedupe: searched `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` for "currency symbol overlap", "currency adornment", "currency prefix input", "CurrencyField symbol" — no open card on this mechanism (all hits closed and about multi-currency resolution, not the adornment width).
